headline: Anthropic Prices Landmark $81 Billion IPO at $83 per Share, Valuing AI Firm at $1.5 Trillion
summary: AI startup Anthropic priced its initial public offering at $83 per share, raising $81 billion and securing a fully diluted valuation of $1.5 trillion in the largest IPO in history.
why: Anthropic is the creator of the Claude AI assistant and a major competitor in generative artificial intelligence. Its massive market debut serves as a primary benchmark for investor appetite and valuations across the entire AI sector.
